rule: specs/19-llm-talk.md section 7 layer D and specs/16-talk-command.md section 7 (D6 Q8). The guard in tools/talk_guard.py is a lowercase substring check over the words list here and reads nothing else from this file; the file cannot change how the check runs. Kept are strong words only: no three letter token (ass, cum, fag, jap, sht, tit, wop) and no token a substring check would fire on inside ordinary speech (asses, crap, coon, paki, pissed, spic) made it in, because the guard eats the whole reply. Missing or fewer than 20 tokens here stops the bake and fails check 6.
source: List of Common Expletives (expletives.json) in dariusk/corpora, Darius Kazemi and contributors

provenance.method: Every token here is one of the 459 bare lowercase a-z words in the source, minus those a substring check would fire on inside ordinary English (ass, asses, crap, fag, tit, coon, paki, spic, smartass, pissed) and minus the mild interjections a 1912 merchant navy scene says out loud (hell, damn, wtf, gtfo, scum tier kept at the strong words only).
